top_news.title: Fully-sensorized smart-eyewear platform for on-device Machine Learning
top_news.dek: The ARGO smart eyewear platform uses the STM32N6 microcontroller to run on-device machine learning for real-time obstacle detection.
top_news.brief: ARGO integrates hardware, firmware, and AI to enable local processing on smart glasses. By utilizing the STM32N6's Neural Processing Unit, it runs an optimized YOLOv11 model for urban obstacle recognition, reducing latency and improving privacy compared to cloud-based alternatives.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram of ARGO smart eyewear hardware architecture

top_news.title: Alibaba’s Tongyi Lab Releases Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS, a Hosted Text-to-Speech Model in Flash and Plus Tiers Across 16 Languages
top_news.dek: Alibaba's Tongyi Lab launched Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS, a hosted text-to-speech service available in Flash and Plus tiers.
top_news.brief: The new TTS system supports 16 languages and is available exclusively via Alibaba Cloud Model Studio. The 'Flash' tier is optimized for low-latency real-time interactions, while the 'Plus' tier focuses on high-fidelity audio generation for production use cases.

top_news.title: Alibaba's Qwen Audio 3.0 TTS Plus tops the competition in the text-to-speech rankings
top_news.dek: Alibaba's Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS-Plus has reached the top of the Artificial Analysis Speech Arena leaderboard.
top_news.brief: The model achieved an Elo score of 1,236, narrowly surpassing Simba 3.2. It supports 16 languages and allows for style control via natural language or tags. However, it is significantly slower than competitors like Sonic 3.5, operating at 16 characters per second.
top_news.image_alt: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena leaderboard showing Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS-Plus in the top position.

top_news.title: Qwen-Image-3.0: Rich Content, Authentic Details, Deep Knowledge
top_news.dek: Alibaba released Qwen-Image-3.0, a foundational image generation model emphasizing realism and complex layout support.
top_news.brief: The third-generation model focuses on 'real' output, supporting up to 4.5k tokens for input. It is designed to handle complex visual structures like storyboards, newspapers, and exam papers with improved authenticity and detail.

top_news.title: Motif-Technologies/Motif-3-Beta (125 downloads, 98 likes)
top_news.dek: Motif Technologies released a beta checkpoint for Motif-3, a proprietary 314B parameter Mixture-of-Experts model.
top_news.brief: Motif-3 is a sparse MoE model featuring 384 experts with 8 active per token. It supports a 256k token context window and was built from the ground up rather than being a re-parameterization of existing architectures. This is an intermediate release ahead of the final model.
top_news.image_alt: Hugging Face repository page for Motif-3-Beta.
